title: 585 Laurelwood Drive (30CDM-25402)
body:
Application for Vacant Land Condominium at 585 Laurelwood Drive
The Applicant is requesting to obtain draft approval for a Vacant Land Condominium Application at 585 Laurelwood Drive.
A Condominium is a form of tenure that identifies individual ownership of units with common elements shared by all unit owners. A Vacant Land Condominium contains vacant units (which are considered to be lots in the City of Waterloo Zoning By-law) rather than units that are contained within a building.
LMRW GP Inc. is proposing a Vacant Land Condominium with four units and common element areas that include driveways, servicing, and amenity areas. Each of the four units are proposed to be developed with a multi-unit residential building.
Building height and housing type
Tallest tower: 12 storeys
Housing types: multi-unit residential
Parking
Parking will be provided at grade and underground.
You can provide feedback to the planning department, and it will be shared with City Council, or ask a question to learn more about this application.
Images are provided by the applicant and may not reflect the final Unit Boundaries approved as the parties move through the process.
